info.name: 366pi Complete Recruitment Microservices Suite
info.description:
Full end-to-end Postman Test Suite covering all 7 recruitment microservices:
1. Discovery Server (Eureka :8761)
2. Admin Server (Spring Boot Admin :8082)
3. Auth Service (:8083)
4. User Service (:8081)
5. Job Service (:8084)
6. Application Service (:8085)
7. Interview Service (:8086)

Fully automated with chained test assertions and variable state management.
